name: capability-questions
title: Capability questions
description: The questions sales hears most, answered with a verdict: yes, yes on a plan, not yet, with the how underneath.
docs: Pass title, items (a question, a verdict of "yes", "plan", "soon" or "no", the plan's name for a plan verdict, an answer, an href and a group id), groups (an id and a heading each) and contact (a line, a link text and an href). Every answer is on the page: it is a list, not an accordion, so it can be scanned, found with the browser's search and indexed. The verdict is a pill with a word and a shape: a check for Yes, a plus for "On Business", a clock for Not yet and a dash for No, each on its own fill, so none depends on colour. The question is the heading; a screen reader hears it, then the verdict, then the answer. A not-yet or no answer should name what to do instead. The questions sit in two columns from 768px of width and in one under that. With groups, each topic gets a heading one level under the section's and the questions sit one more under it; without, the questions sit directly under the section's heading. labels translates the pills and the docs link.
